posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina is serving major yellow fashion inspiration this summer alongside Alia, Kriti, and Triptii. Rumors of a reunion with Ranbir Kapoor in Raajneeti 2 are also making waves.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit made history as the first Indian artist to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden. His new film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman hits theaters June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha, Alia's YRF Spy Universe film with Sharvari, moves up to July 3 for an open box office window. She plays an assassin raised and built to kill in the franchise's edgy origin story.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka presented at both the Golden Globes and Oscars 2026, dazzling in custom Dior alongside Nick Jonas. She continues to represent Indian talent on Hollywood's biggest stages.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is reportedly set to headline a big-budget romantic drama after King. Meanwhile, Karan Johar unfollowing him on Instagram has sparked massive speculation online.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is trending after Karan Johar's surprise Instagram unfollow spree. She was recently spotted on a safari getaway with Alia and Varun, sparking summer travel trends.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha continues to ride the massive success of Stree 2 which broke box office records. She graciously acknowledged SRK as 'an absolutely fantastic leading man' when asked about surpassing Pathaan.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy and was spotted stepping out with Ranveer in a protective outing. She's currently filming King with Shah Rukh Khan.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay starts shooting in August with a reported ₹300 crore budget. Don 3 is making headlines amid the FWICE controversy, with RGV backing him publicly.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with multiple couture looks — from swan-inspired to cosmic muse in Amit Aggarwal's 'Luminara.' She urged young actors to reject manufactured trends and embrace authenticity.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika married Vijay Deverakonda in a fairytale Udaipur wedding. She's promoting Cocktail 2 with Shahid and Kriti, releasing June 19 — trailer just dropped.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram trailer shows her in a fierce new avatar — a film she also produced. She's reportedly in talks to reunite with Allu Arjun in an Atlee-directed project.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: After Pushpa 2's record-breaking run, Allu Arjun is reportedly in talks for director Atlee's next big-budget film. A potential reunion with Samantha Ruth Prabhu has fans buzzing.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports action drama Peddi with Janhvi Kapoor releases June 4. The AR Rahman-scored film features him as a multi-sport village legend in a journey of self-discovery.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's War 2 with Hrithik Roshan and Kiara Advani releases August 14 in the YRF Spy Universe. The film has already set records with the fastest $100K advance sales for an Indian film in North America.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is deep in Peddi promotions with Ram Charan, revealing that airport authorities abroad now ask Indian actors about RRR and Ram Charan — calling him 'the reference point for Indians in America.'

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya is making fashion headlines with Clark Kent-to-baddie era transformations. She was among the celebs unfollowed by Karan Johar in his surprise Instagram cleanup.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars alongside Hrithik and Jr NTR in War 2, releasing August 14. She earned her biggest salary yet for Don 3 with Ranveer Singh and is prepping intensive martial arts training.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's War 2 wrapped after 149 days of filming and releases August 14 in IMAX. He revealed he 'struggled' to match Kiara Advani's dance steps in the Aavan Jaavan sequence.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan locks June 5 release after Toxic's postponement. He thanked Yash for clearing the date, calling it 'the first film to release post IPL.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya drops new song 'Siddha Bhajo' on June 1 — a deeply personal track her father always wanted her to record. Her 'Unstoppable Tour' kicks off June 20 in Auckland, covering 16+ cities worldwide.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman called Vedang Raina a 'real singer' at the Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer launch. His daughters rallied support after his 'communal' remarks about declining Bollywood work sparked debate.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Now Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister, Vijay's final film Jana Nayagan still awaits censor certification. The film was leaked online but the producer says release will be 'grand' once clearance arrives.
